items.passage: Transcript: Hi everyone, Sven Ito from the student health centre. Our flu vaccine clinic starts next week, and a few things work differently this year. Our lobby has never been busier. So instead of lining up there like last year, you'll come to Room 248 in the Bramwell Centre. Tuesday and Wednesday are by appointment. Thursday is walk-in, because that's when we have extra nurses from the city hospital. To book a Tuesday or Wednesday slot, please don't use the patient portal. I know that's how every other appointment works, but the portal can't see the clinic's calendar, and neither can our front desk. Phone extension 7114 instead. If you have a question about insurance, that's a different line, extension 7129. The vaccine itself is free, so there's nothing to pay on the day.
items.prompt: [Announcement — Student health centre] What should a student who wants a flu vaccine on Wednesday do first?
choices: Phone extension 7114 and book a time slot
Call extension 7129 and book a time slot
Book a time slot through the patient portal
Ask the front desk to book a time slot
items.correct_answer: Phone extension 7114 and book a time slot
items.explanation: Wednesday is "by appointment," and to book a Tuesday or Wednesday slot the speaker says "Phone extension 7114 instead." "Book a time slot through the patient portal" is the usual method, but "the portal can't see the clinic's calendar." "Ask the front desk to book a time slot" is wrong: "neither can our front desk." "Call extension 7129 and book a time slot" uses the insurance line: "If you have a question about insurance, that's a different line, extension 7129."
